19 个作者节点把木纤维、裸木颜色和剥落油漆变成可编辑的 PBR 材质。颜色校正: 19 authoring nodes turn wood fibers, bare-wood colors and peeling paint into an editable PBR material. 以已有生成木箱参考的表面为视觉目标，建立一套不使用参考图像素烘焙的程序化旧漆木材: Use the surface of an existing generated crate reference as the visual target for a procedural aged-paint wood material without baking reference-image pixels into it. Retain adjustable paint coverage, bare-wood color, wood-grain height and roughness, and export native PBR channels for use in other rendering applications.
通过 DCC-MCP 在 Substance 3D Designer 16 中制: Use DCC-MCP to create editable olive-green aged-paint wood in Substance 3D Designer 16. Use the existing crate reference only to observe color and wear; do not bake reference-image pixels into the material. Build wood grain with Wood Fibers 1 and blend two bare-wood colors. Use Grunge Leaky Paint and Levels to create a peeling-paint mask that also drives roughness, Height and Normal, while keeping Metallic at zero. Expose the paint_coverage parameter and save it as 0.70. Correct paint RGB from 87/89/62 to 99/96/74, and correct bare-wood endpoints to 0.35/0.29/0.215 and 0.69/0.60/0.46. Natively export 1024×1024 Base Color, Height, Normal, Roughness and Metallic textures, save SBS and SBSAR files, capture the complete node graph and live material preview, and record file hashes and actual tool calls. Report capability gaps without bypassing them through direct application scripts.
